messages:
Emma: Quick sync — we need a one-pager checklist for the upcoming marketplace + SI bundle (SSO/SCIM, KMS/HSM, secrets manager). Can ops/security and eng confirm requirements?
Liam: @Emma will do. Main asks from security: cert rotation, KMS envelope flow, audit log export, and SCIM provisioning throttles.
Raj: From eng side: health-check endpoint, sample docker-compose for on-prem SI, and an example token exchange flow for KMS auth.
Olivia: Sales needs a short bullet list for the partner-facing doc: supported idPs, HSM vendors, marketplace launch timeline. 1 pager only.
Emma: Good. I'll draft. Can someone paste a minimal SCIM provisioning example we can include?
Raj: Pasting a tiny example we use in dev for testing: ```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.smith@example.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "J", "familyName": "Smith"},
  "emails": [{"value": "j.smith@example.com", "type": "work"}]
}
```
Liam: For KMS auth, we want to recommend mTLS + short-lived creds. Example header for service-to-service: ```
Authorization: Bearer v1.sesstoken
X-Client-Cert-Fingerprint: abc123...
```
Olivia: Can we call out supported secrets managers? We currently certify: AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault (enterprise + cloud), Azure Key Vault.
Emma: Perfect, Olivia — add that. Raj, what's the health-check path?
Raj: `/healthz` returns JSON with `uptime`, `kv_cache_hits`, `last_sync_ts`. We'll include sample curl: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://partner.internal/healthz`
Liam: Also add a section: compliance-ready artifacts (SOC2 report, pen-test summary, SLAs). Partners care.
Emma: Noted. Olivia, timeline?
Olivia: Partner wants a joint announcement in ~6 weeks. We need integration test sign-off in 3 weeks to make marketing assets.
Emma: Ok — draft checklist for partner:
- SCIM: endpoint, sample payload, provisioning throttles, error mappings
- SSO/SAML: IdP metadata exchange, SP metadata, cert rollover window (90 days)
- KMS/HSM: supported vendors, mTLS + token flow, envelope encryption sample
- Secrets manager: supported vendors, rotation cadence, access patterns
- Ops: healthz endpoint, logging exports, alerting hooks
- Compliance: list of artifacts + contacts
Raj: I'll attach a tiny docker-compose snippet for local testing in the doc.
Olivia: I'll prep the partner-facing bullets and the timeline slide.
Emma: Great. Can we reconvene for a 20-min checkpoint tomorrow 11am PT?
Liam: Works for me.
Raj: I'll be there.
Olivia: ✅
deploy-bot: Reminder: partnership-docs pipeline build succeeded (build 31456) — artifacts at https://ci.redwood/integration/31456
Emma: Thanks — everyone, please drop any doc links in thread before EOD so I can collate.
